description: Socket at bench B12 has scorch marks and a loose faceplate with wires visible. Sparked when a soldering iron was plugged in.
risk_summary: Exposed wiring and scorch marks at a lab bench socket in an active MakerSpace. There is a risk of electric shock and fire, especially with students using soldering equipment nearby. Recommend isolating the circuit and cordoning off the bench until an electrician inspects it.

location: SIT@Punggol Coast, Level 2 Library, Male Toilet
description: Water leaking from under the washbasin and pooling across the floor towards the corridor. Floor is slippery.
risk_summary: Active water leak creating a slip hazard near a busy library corridor. Water may spread to nearby flooring and electrical points if left unattended. Recommend placing wet floor signs, shutting the local valve and dispatching a plumber.

description: Projector flickers and turns off after about 10 minutes of use. Lecture had to switch to the backup display.
risk_summary: Intermittent projector failure disrupting lectures, with no immediate safety risk. Possible overheating or lamp failure. Recommend AV team inspect the lamp and ventilation before the next scheduled lecture.
